about.headline: Interaction Design Student focusing on human-centred AI systems
about.bio: My interest lies in computer vision and AI. While working with data and AI systems, I recognised the critical importance of addressing how we interact with these technologies. This realisation led towards shifting my focus to designing AI systems through a human-centred lens, ensuring that technology serves people in meaningful and intuitive ways.
about.philosophy: With experience working as a developer, I gained understanding of how systems are designed and built. I believe the best solutions emerge when user needs are thoughtfully balanced with system requirements. Ultimately, I aim to create products with exceptional usability and technical simplicity, then iterating with clever designs and thoughtful refinements.
about.availability: Currently open to internships, research positions, and collaborative opportunities in interaction design and human-AI systems.
